channel.title: DUNADRON – Drone Tech News
channel.description: Weekly roundup of the latest drone technology: FPV, thermal imaging, autonomy, regulation and industry.

item.title: EU Drone Summit sets the course for a secure European drone market and a Trusted Drone Label
item.description: More than 400 industry and government participants met in Brussels to review the EU Drone Strategy 2.0. The first findings of the European Trusted Drone Label pilot were published, and an implementation roadmap is due in 2027.

item.title: DARPA EVADE: flight tests continue for Sikorsky's Nomad long-endurance VTOL drone
item.description: Sikorsky's flying-wing Nomad prototype is one of the designs flying under DARPA's $47M EVADE programme, which seeks uncrewed VTOL aircraft with fixed-wing endurance.

item.title: FAA grants first-of-its-kind authorization for long-range drone flights from the US coast to offshore platforms
item.description: The US regulator authorized an autonomous VTOL drone to fly beyond visual line of sight from Louisiana to an offshore energy platform, including a pipeline inspection and a simulated equipment delivery.

item.title: Skyways launches Skyreach, a hybrid long-range autonomous cargo VTOL
item.description: The new autonomous VTOL combines electric vertical flight with fuel-powered cruise for over 1,300 miles of range and 18+ hours of endurance, with a modular bay for cargo, sensors or communications.

item.title: DJI Matrice 5T brings native 1280×1024 thermal imaging to compact enterprise drones
item.description: The new IP55 enterprise drone pairs a native 1K thermal camera with enhanced night vision, LiDAR and mmWave radar obstacle sensing, onboard AI and up to 59 minutes of flight time.

item.title: ETH Zurich's FlexiQuad: a soft-frame drone that keeps flying after collisions
item.description: Researchers built a quadrotor with a deformable frame that absorbs impacts yet reaches 80 km/h, opening the door to inspection and rescue flights in tight, cluttered spaces.
